links.comparator_used: Same radiographs without CLAHE (unmodified images), same trained model
links.outcome: Scaphoid fracture detection accuracy and false-negative rate
links.effect: CLAHE increased the false-negative rate; no numeric values given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: CLAHE contrast enhancement applied at inference raised the false-negative rate, so missed fractures are a new failure mode.
links.quote: Gaussian blur caused the most substantial performance drop, whereas contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization increased the false-negative rate.

design_hint: image quality control (resolution and blur checks)
